title.zh: 对第 7532 号共和国法的修改
title.en: An Act Amending Republic Act No. 7532, Converting the Batangas Regional Hospital to the Batangas Medical Center, Further Increasing its Bed Capacity to Five Hundred (500) Beds
title.orig: An Act Amending Republic Act No. 7532, Converting the Batangas Regional Hospital to the Batangas Medical Center, Further Increasing its Bed Capacity to Five Hundred (500) Beds

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2009/ra_9791_2009.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Republic Act No. 7532, is hereby amended by inserting a new Section 1, to read as follows:
"SECTION 1. The Batangas Regional Hospital in Batangas City shall be converted into a medical center and shall hereafter be known as the Batangas Medical Center."

Section 1 of Republic Act No. 7532, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"SEC. 2. The bed capacity of the Batangas Medical Center is hereby increased from two hundred fifty (250) beds to five hundred (500) beds."
This Act shall take effect upon its publication in at least two (2) newspapers of general circulation.
